facts.business: RKD Agri & Retail Limited (formerly Himalchuli Food Products Limited) is an Indian listed company engaged in agri and retail business.
key_risks: Non-compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations regarding newspaper advertisements for AGM, e-voting, and book closure
Non-compliance with Section 108 of Companies Act 2013 for e-voting newspaper notice
Non-compliance with Section 91 of Companies Act 2013 for book closure newspaper advertisement
